results.name: Kharkovchanka
results.description:
A detailed game-ready asset of the iconic Soviet Antarctic heavy traverse vehicle, the "Kharkovchanka" (Soviet Antarctic Expedition / САЭ). Built to conquer extreme polar environments, the design emphasizes rugged industrial utility: heavy tracks, riveted panel seams, distinctive expedition markings, and weathered paintwork. The goal of this project was to achieve an authentic vintage look while maintaining a clean, game-optimized pipeline from initial blockout to final bake and render.

Technical Details:
Workflow: PBR Metallic/Roughness
Topology: Optimized for Games
Polycount: 38,000 Polygons / 38,000 Tris (Total Face Count)
Textures: 1x 4K Texture Set (All-in-one set)

Software Used:
Autodesk Maya — Low-poly modeling & asset preparation
RizomUV — UV unwrapping & packing
Marmoset Toolbag — High-to-Low map baking & scene rendering
Adobe Substance 3D Painter — PBR texturing, multi-layer paint wear, and materials
Adobe Photoshop — Decal creation and graphic assets

results.name: Minecart Railway Low-Poly Underground Mine Props
results.description:
**A game-ready 3D Minecart and Environment Asset Pack, perfectly suited for dark, atmospheric underground settings. **

This collection was originally created as props for the "Abandoned Mineshaft" layout in the 2020 Hallo Comp. This pack features a highly detailed wooden and steel minecart with a classic 4-wheel chassis and a functional tipping container designed to tilt side-to-side for interactive gameplay. To help you build out a complete low-poly or realistic underground scene, the pack now also includes modular railway tracks and a weathered mineshaft wooden roof support pillar.It is the ideal asset bundle for horror games, historical exploration levels, underground dungeon crawlers, or survival-crafting environments.

## Key Features:
* Authentic weathered wood and iron finish
   * Side-tipping cargo tub
   * Front-facing headlight lantern
   * Optimised geometry for real-time game engines
   * Railway Track
   * Mineshaft Roof Support Pillar.

Modelled in Blender, Textured in Substance Painter
